caption: The drawing features a brown eagle with its wings slightly spread and head turned to its left, positioned at the center of the composition. Above the eagle, a grayish ribbon banner extends outward in both directions, held in the eagle’s beak, and contains the text “E PLURIBUS UNUM” in uppercase letters, with “E PLURIBUS” on the left and “UNUM” on the right. Draped around the eagle’s lower body on both sides are two cloth banners: the left banner is colored in shades of blue and white and features a pattern of white stars, while the right banner is in white and grayish blue. Beneath the eagle and draped banners is a horizontal decorative base consisting of ornate golden scrollwork, accentuated with darker shading for depth, and the base is grounded by a black strip along the bottom. The background is a plain, unadorned off-white or cream color, with no additional objects or scenery.
title: Eagle
